Discussion This systematic review is the first to describe the overall duration and severity of diarrhea among children and adults. To estimate the annual number of diarrhea epi- sodes among children under-five by region, we applied the regional age-adjusted incidences of diarrhea among children 0-59 mos of age to the regional populations of children in that age group.
